title: Integral and rational orientation pair
statement: Fix a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] at a finite coefficient field. Use the integral shifted root line and its actual pullback and product from [def-sf-orientation-scalar-line-comparisons], and the geometric comparison equations of [def-sf-orientation-geometric-comparisons]. Integral comparison coordinates consist of root-normalized pullback, product and unit coordinates and the actual A2/A3 coordinates on the smooth morphisms used by the family. An integral/rational pair supplies an integral geometric family, the rationalization image coordinates prescribed by A5, a rational geometric family and the equation $w C(\gamma)=\gamma't$ for rationalization, where the image line comparison is the identity. This is data with equations, not an existence assertion.
